campaign_scope_target_check.name: campaign_scope_target_check
campaign_scope_target_check.value: ("campaigns"."scope" = 'all' AND "campaigns"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("campaigns"."scope" <> 'all' AND "campaigns"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

campaign_date_check.name: campaign_date_check
campaign_date_check.value: "campaigns"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "campaigns"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "campaigns"."ends_at" > "campaigns"."starts_at"

coupon_usage_check.name: coupon_usage_check
coupon_usage_check.value: "coupons"."max_uses_per_customer" > 0 AND "coupons"."used_count" >= 0 AND ("coupons"."max_uses_total" IS NULL OR ("coupons"."max_uses_total" > 0 AND "coupons"."used_count" <= "coupons"."max_uses_total"))

coupon_date_check.name: coupon_date_check
coupon_date_check.value: "coupons"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "coupons"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "coupons"."ends_at" > "coupons"."starts_at"
